basics.name: Alexander Prytula
basics.label: Engineering Manager
basics.summary: Engineering Manager and Technical Leader with experience managing delivery across multiple cross-functional R&D teams. Skilled at aligning technical execution with business objectives, unblocking engineering bottlenecks, and mentoring engineers. Experienced in acting as a Scrum Master, improving deployment predictability, and working closely with VP-level stakeholders to resolve organizational and technical pain points.

work.name: Sisense

Investigated team ownership, code quality, delivery processes, and engineer pain points to identify the domain's most critical organizational and technical bottlenecks.
Wrote a comprehensive report with strategic recommendations and presented it directly to the department manager and VP of Engineering.
Partnered with engineering leadership to align technical execution, release processes, and quality improvements with business goals.
Designed and implemented a QA strategy that improved test coverage, strengthened release confidence, and clarified team responsibilities.

work.name: Sisense

Coordinated delivery of AI-enabled product capabilities across data science, product engineering, backend, frontend, and DevOps workstreams.
Mentored engineers on technical decision-making, implementation quality, testing practices, and production readiness.

work.name: Sisense
